payload.answer:
**1. Modification to the Streaming Ingestion Latency SLA (DATA-SLA-3.1)**
* In the base solicitation (`01_RFP_Data_Platform.pdf`, Page 1), Clause DATA-SLA-3.1 originally required that end-to-end streaming ingestion latency from Cloud Pub/Sub through Apache Beam / Dataflow into BigQuery Silver tables not exceed 30 seconds (p99).
* Addendum 0001 (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, Page 1) supersedes Clause DATA-SLA-3.1 to support real-time fraud detection, reducing the maximum end-to-end Pub/Sub to Dataflow to BigQuery Silver streaming latency from 30 seconds down to 5 seconds (p99 <= 5.0 seconds) using BigQuery Storage Write API committed streams.

**2. Modification to the Annual Cost for 6,000 TB of Active Lakehouse Storage (CLIN-1004)**
* In the base pricing schedule (`03_Pricing_and_Volume_Tiers.pdf`, Page 1), CLIN-1004 (Active Lakehouse Storage) for a monthly quantity of 6,000 TB was priced at a base unit rate of $20.00/TB/mo for an annual total of $1,440,000.
* Addendum 0001 (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, Page 1) supersedes CLIN-1004 by introducing a 15% volume discount for Active Lakehouse Storage exceeding 5 Petabytes (5,000 TB), which reduces the effective rate from $20.00/TB/mo to $17.00/TB/mo and lowers the annual cost for 6,000 TB from $1,440,000 to $1,224,000.

**3. Three Medallion Storage Layers in the Architecture Diagram**
* In Exhibit A (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1), the Lakehouse Medallion Pipeline specification (ARCH-MEDALLION-02) and vector diagram define three Medallion storage layers in BigQuery and BigLake Iceberg:
  * **Bronze Layer (`BigQuery Bronze (Raw)`)**: Consists of raw append-only change-data-capture (CDC) tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).
  * **Silver Layer (`BigQuery Silver (Curated)`)**: Consists of deduplicated, schema-enforced enterprise entity tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).
  * **Gold Layer (`BigQuery Gold (Governed)`)**: Consists of governed semantic marts and Vertex AI Feature Store embeddings (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).

payload.answer:
**1. Modification to the Streaming Ingestion Latency SLA (DATA-SLA-3.1)**
* In the base solicitation (`01_RFP_Data_Platform.pdf`, Page 1), Clause DATA-SLA-3.1 originally required that end-to-end streaming ingestion latency from Cloud Pub/Sub through Apache Beam / Dataflow into BigQuery Silver tables not exceed 30 seconds (p99).
* Addendum 0001 (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, Page 1) supersedes Clause DATA-SLA-3.1 to support real-time fraud detection, reducing the maximum end-to-end Pub/Sub to Dataflow to BigQuery Silver streaming latency from 30 seconds down to 5 seconds (p99 <= 5.0 seconds) using BigQuery Storage Write API committed streams.

**2. Modification to the Annual Cost for 6,000 TB of Active Lakehouse Storage (CLIN-1004)**
* In the base pricing schedule (`03_Pricing_and_Volume_Tiers.pdf`, Page 1), CLIN-1004 (Active Lakehouse Storage) for a monthly quantity of 6,000 TB was priced at a base unit rate of $20.00/TB/mo for an annual total of $1,440,000.
* Addendum 0001 (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, Page 1) supersedes CLIN-1004 by introducing a 15% volume discount for Active Lakehouse Storage exceeding 5 Petabytes (5,000 TB), which reduces the effective rate from $20.00/TB/mo to $17.00/TB/mo and lowers the annual cost for 6,000 TB from $1,440,000 to $1,224,000.

**3. Three Medallion Storage Layers in the Architecture Diagram**
* In Exhibit A (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1), the Lakehouse Medallion Pipeline specification (ARCH-MEDALLION-02) and vector diagram define three Medallion storage layers in BigQuery and BigLake Iceberg:
  * **Bronze Layer (`BigQuery Bronze (Raw)`)**: Consists of raw append-only change-data-capture (CDC) tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).
  * **Silver Layer (`BigQuery Silver (Curated)`)**: Consists of deduplicated, schema-enforced enterprise entity tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).
  * **Gold Layer (`BigQuery Gold (Governed)`)**: Consists of governed semantic marts and Vertex AI Feature Store embeddings (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).
